episode_summary: Chris Linsell discusses the potential transformation of Zillow into a major brokerage and the implications for real estate agents. The episode also covers the stalled 21st Century Road to Housing Act and its potential impact on inventory. Linsell emphasizes the importance of niche marketing based on lifestyle to differentiate agents in a rapidly changing industry.
